verdict.rationale: Hatchet documents a `hatchet worker dev` command that runs a worker locally with auto-reload, and lists an 'Embedded Mode' docs page and self-hosting of the control plane. There is no evidence that one command brings up the whole engine, or of any workflow testing utilities. missing for 10: a single command that runs the full engine/control plane locally, unit-testing utilities for workflows, time skipping, mocked steps, independent corroboration.
